description:
First concrete step for the v0.5 UI epic. Lands the binary target, the egui/eframe dependency, and a no-op render so subsequent subtasks (fs watcher, CLI outbound, git-tree renderer) have a crate to land in.

=== Stack decision ===

egui/eframe. Pivoted from Dioxus-desktop because Dioxus-desktop (like Tauri and Electron) requires libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev on Linux — a heavy, version-specific system dep that breaks portability and containerization. egui is winit-based and draws itself via GPU primitives; its system deps (X11/Wayland core libs) are universally present on any system with a display. Immediate-mode rendering — different mental model from Dioxus's reactive components, but fine for the git-tree + streaming-text + indicators load.

A future sibling crate 'lernie-ui-web' could ship Dioxus-web (WASM) or Leptos for browser-based rendering; the shared view-model lib would be reused across both per ARCH §3.5 pluggability.

=== What to build ===

- New binary crate named 'lernie-ui-egui'. Naming follows 'lernie-provider-<name>' for pluggable integrations (ARCH §3.5): a future webclient would be 'lernie-ui-web', a TUI would be 'lernie-ui-tui'.
- eframe + egui dependencies pinned to current stable.
- Entry point opens an eframe window rendering a placeholder: 'lernie — no conversation loaded'.
- CLI args: '--repo <path>' accepted but unused by this task (later tasks will use it). Bare invocation prints usage and exits non-zero.
- Strict statelessness (§3.5): no disk or process-level persistent state. Any in-memory state is ephemeral UI state (window size, scroll, selection) only.
- Makefile: 'make build', 'make release', 'make install' all include the new binary. 'make install' copies it into \$INSTALL_PREFIX/bin alongside lernie and lernie-provider-anthropic.

=== Out of scope ===

- Filesystem watching (next task).
- CLI outbound / 'exec lernie ...' wrapper (next task).
- Any actual rendering of repo state (next task).
- Browser-based siblings (future crate).

=== Design decision to resolve at claim time ===

Workspace vs multi-bin single-crate. Lean: promote the repo to a Cargo workspace with members '.' (existing lernie) and 'crates/lernie-ui-egui' (new). Keeps core harness build lean; egui deps only pulled when building the UI crate.

=== Testing ===

Per repo discipline: cargo test + tarpaulin --fail-under 100. Pure view-model functions unit-testable in isolation. egui rendering tested via 'egui::Context::run' in a headless test harness — construct a context, run one frame, assert on the UI tree via 'egui::util' or by inspecting the paint primitives. No window required for tests.

No live network or filesystem mutation.
title: UI skeleton: lernie-ui-egui binary + Cargo wiring
